subject: Runtime/Platform allocation & governance for Q3 headcount
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime/Platform: proposed allocation & governance for Q3 headcount

Hi Kimberly / Karthik —

I've attached a short proposal (HC_Plan_Q3.xlsx) to reallocate two seats from the Platform general pool into Runtime/Infra for Q3. Summary ask:

- 1 x Senior Runtime SWE (E5) — primary focus: kernel+latency regressions and kernel releases
- 1 x Staff SRE (E6) — primary focus: GPU pool reliability and autoscaling policies
- 1 x Perf/Quant engineer (contract-to-FTE target) — deferred hire option if budget constrained

Rationale: recent production incidents and upcoming model rollouts increase required servicing and kernel churn. Batching/kv-cache work needs a dedicated SWE to avoid blocking model onboarding. The HC file includes estimates for OTE and expected first-billable dates.

Attachments: HC_Plan_Q3.xlsx (headcount + ramp timeline), comp-band-summary.pdf (initial bands).

Ask: can we reassign 2 confirmed platform slots into runtime (Staff SRE + Senior SWE) and allow the Quant role as a conditional conversion of a contractor depending on Q4 budget? Looking for a governance nod (Irene) and comp-band confirmation (Kimberly) so we can start pipelining candidates.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime/Platform: proposed allocation & governance for Q3 headcount

Thanks Marcus — quick questions before I sign off: 

1) Can you call out the comp-band deltas vs the baseline platform hires (numbers in comp-band-summary.pdf look higher for the E5 slot). We need the delta against the original platform budget line to route this through finance.
2) What is the expected blended ramp cost for Q3 (FTEs start dates + first 90d) — please put in the HC sheet a per-month burn row.
3) If we convert a contractor to the quant role, who is the manager of record for performance eval/promotions? That affects the approval path.

Also add a JIRA link to the hiring request (preferably a single ticket for the three roles) so People Ops has a clear artifact to attach.

Cc'ing Karthik for governance input.

-kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Compensation & Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime/Platform: proposed allocation & governance for Q3 headcount

Kimberly — thanks, quick update inline and attached comp-band-summary.pdf with deltas.

- Comp delta: the Senior Runtime SWE budget (E5) has a +8% OTE delta vs the baseline Platform E5 because of scarcity for low-latency kernel experience. Staff SRE (E6) is within the existing reserved band for SRE roles. Quant/Perf is listed as contract conversion with a modest premium (approx +12% opex if converted). Details in comp-band-summary.pdf.

- Ramp/burn: I've added a per-month burn row in HC_Plan_Q3.xlsx. If we hire by July 1: Q3 incremental burn = $48k (two FTE partial-quarter), Q4 run-rate = $420k/year for the three roles combined (on OTE basis).

- Manager of record: both SWE and SRE report to me; quant role would report to the Perf/Quant lead (contractor currently reports to Data Science) — we propose dotted-line to Runtime for day-to-day. If People Ops prefers a strict single manager policy, we can convert but it changes org reporting.

Drive link with live budget sheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_runtime_hc_plan
Attached: comp-band-summary.pdf

I'll create a single JIRA for the request (INFRA-1428) and update the HC sheet with ticket reference.

- Marcus
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-03-23T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime/Platform: proposed allocation & governance for Q3 headcount

Thank you — forwarding to procurement and looping in Acme's technical lead (Asha) because there is a runway dependency: if Acme signs the managed-inference addendum next month we need the extra SWE earlier to complete kernel work for their model set. A couple of governance asks from my side: 

- We need HC committee signoff for any permanent reallocation of platform pool seats. Please prepare a 1-page summary for the HC committee (problem, proposed roles, cost delta, ask).
- Propose a compromise path: approve 2 hires now (Staff SRE + Senior SWE) and defer the quant conversion until Q4 pending contract review and spend approval. That minimizes near-term budget impact.
- Procurement: please confirm whether Acme has an advance credits schedule or milestone payment that can offset part of Q3 burn. If they can accelerate payment we can pull the quant hire into Q3.

Asha / procurement — can you confirm milestone timing and whether there is any pre-payment clause we should consider?

-Karthik
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha@acme.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: 2027-03-24T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime/Platform: proposed allocation & governance for Q3 headcount

Reviewed the materials and the ask — I approve reallocation of two platform seats (Senior Runtime SWE + Staff SRE) to Runtime/Infra under the following conditions: 

1) Kimberly / People Ops to confirm comp-band deltas and sign off on offer ranges prior to extending offers.
2) Marcus to produce the 1-page HC committee summary (Karthik's template) and submit INFRA-1428 for committee review; committee meeting slot requested for 03/29.
3) The quant/perf role is deferred to Q4 unless Acme confirms an accelerated payment schedule that covers at least 50% of Q3 incremental burn. Acme procurement — please respond with milestone timing by EOD 3/25.

Kimberly: please coordinate offers for the two approved roles once People Ops completes band confirmation. Marcus: start pipeline and share candidate scorecard templates with People Ops.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
VP Infrastructure & Platform
Redwood Inference
